svg.title: RAG evaluation maturity pyramid
svg.desc: Five stages of evaluating a RAG system: component level testing the retriever and generator in isolation, pipeline level running the RAG triad on real retrieved context, application level judging the whole product on correctness, completeness, style, safety and operations, regression as a repeatable activity, and online monitoring on live traffic that feeds a self-improving loop back into the golden dataset.

g.text: same metrics, now on real retrieved context, end to end
is it shippable? judged as a deliverable, not mechanics
4. Regression - an activity, not new metrics
5. Online - live traffic, no golden answer
production failures feed back into the component-level golden set
↻ triggers the next offline evaluation run
